text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Man
text_block_list.text:
An undefeated Triple Crown sweep across 
the Classic campaign! Though she was 
outmaneuvered by Katsuragi Ace in the 
Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Man
text_block_list.text:
"Settling the score brilliantly at the 
recent Arima Kinen, she delivered an 
almost godlike record throughout the 
entire year."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Man
text_block_list.text:
Starting with Symboli Rudolf, our Symboli 
household has produced countless wonderful 
horse girls.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Man
text_block_list.text:
To the brilliant future that awaits them— 
Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Year's end. I was invited to the Symboli 
family year-end party and attended 
alongside Sirius Symboli, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A party showcasing the immense influence 
of the Symboli family was hardly something 
I was accustomed to.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...Pathetic. This happens every year, so 
hurry up and get used to it."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The heater's too hot. I'm gonna go get 
some air.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, I was left all alone by myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her Trainer, just standing in the 
corner probably won't do. As I was racking 
my brain for a plan—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Good evening. Mind if we talk for a bit? 
Sirius's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Student Council President of Tracen 
Academy, and the very person Sirius 
Symboli views as her nemesis—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf, an Umamusume who wishes 
for the happiness of all Umamusume, called 
out to me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha...! I see. Summing it up with just 
'get used to it' is as strict as ever.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Still, she may look that way, but she's 
kind at heart. She only said that because 
she judged you were capable of it."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...She has always been a multifaceted 
child. I've always found it a shame that 
people tend to judge her based on only one 
side."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unlike Sirius Symboli, it seems Symboli 
Rudolf doesn't actually dislike her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...? What's wrong? Is there something on 
my face?
choice_data_list:
No, I just thought you're really sweet to 
Sirius.

No, I was just thinking how kind you are 
to Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Maybe it's because people at the 
academy often see us bumping heads.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
True, I can't say we're on good terms. 
Even so, that doesn't mean I'm giving up 
on our relationship.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: To me, Sirius is a precious Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She is one of the Umamusume whose future I 
must pray for and guide toward the light.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly from what Mejiro 
Ramonu told me—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—That was precisely why Sirius was 
special.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli and Symboli Rudolf were 
supposed to be one of a kind to each 
other.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Does that mean things have changed now?
choice_data_list:
Is she now just another Umamusume I'm 
meant to guide?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I asked, Symboli Rudolf showed a 
slight hint of hesitation—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. You can be quite harsh as well, 
can't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, she soon smiled again with her 
usual resolute demeanor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Happiness for all Umamusume"—this was a 
dream shining far further away than I had 
imagined.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To reach the top, one must discipline 
oneself. Personal feelings of treating 
something as "special"— can at times 
become nothing more than shackles.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
... We cannot allow ourselves to stray 
from the path, can we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli truly, deeply respected 
Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because Symboli Rudolf was there, she grew 
stronger, even resolving to surpass her 
one day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps to Sirius Symboli, Symboli 
Rudolf's current stance feels terribly 
lonely."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could that be why she's usually so quick 
to lash out like that—?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ――G. ...Tch... Hey, pup!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
………… You've been pretty spaced out since 
the other day, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Is there something more interesting to you 
than what I'm saying? Huh? What is it? 
Spit it out.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Or were you groveling over something you 
couldn't bring yourself to tell me? Huh?"
choice_data_list:
...Are you feeling lonely right now, 
Sirius?

...Are you feeling lonely right now, 
Sirius?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Are you stupid? I don't care what she 
thinks of me right now.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I haven't felt lonely for a single damn 
second. Don't say such creepy nonsense.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
“—Come. I'll teach you. It's annoying 
having your head in the clouds forever.”

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Sayin' we used to be thick as thieves... 
..................ain't wrong.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Just to be clear, though, who she is now 
and who she was back then are two totally 
different things."

text_block_list.name: Young Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "HAAAAAAAH!!"

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoa!! W-Whoaaah! That's seriously 
incredible...!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Her usual behavior ain't all that 
different. But how she runs in races... 
ferocious, merciless. Calling it 
captivating wouldn't even begin to cover 
it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
She gazes upon the runners with a 
bone-chilling glare, thoroughly crushing 
them into the dirt.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"That 'Symboli Rudolf' was once even my 
goal. However—"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Before anyone realized it, she had shed 
those fangs of hers.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, well. Leave it to Rudolf. Even for a 
mock race, that's quite the audience. Talk 
about popular.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(For a while before entering Tracen 
Academy, I dedicated myself entirely to 
training and didn't see that guy at all. 
So—)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Show me just how strong you've gotten, 
Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I hope it meets your approval.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh!? What's wrong, Rudolf...! Why 
don't you have that beastly look in your 
eyes?! Why the hell are you reading the 
flow of the race...!?)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(—No, that's not all... Something's 
different. What is it—)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (...Ngh, damn it! My legs won't move!)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...! *pant*, *pant*! *pant*!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Sirius, this is the path I have chosen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be someone who can guide you— 
who can guide *all of you*."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"True, dependin' on how you look at it, 
she's stronger now. Keepin' a good 
position and patiently waitin' up 
front—that's a textbook 'winnin' race.'"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's not about how you do it. ...The 
problem is your attitude.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"A role model, a guide, the happiness of 
all Umamusume. You involved yourself in 
management and took on useless baggage."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
As a result, I couldn't focus solely on 
polishing my running. ...There's no way 
that wouldn't come back to bite me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Sirius Symboli's tone was quiet, lacking 
its usual domineering presence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even those eyes that always stare sharply 
ahead felt somehow, faintly shadowed—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...I'll never acknowledge someone who 
tries to chase two hares at once.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Being a goal is a thing of the past. 
Now... all I want is to paint over the 
brilliant legacy *that guy* built.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't race that punk even if they 
begged me on their knees. They're not 
worth it anymore.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I've explained this much and you're still 
not convinced?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"I hate liars. You should already know 
that, shouldn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...It didn't look like they were lying.
choice_data_list:
(But, when I think about how she 
seemed...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her voice lacks vigor, and her eyes seem 
somewhat dim. ...I simply cannot believe 
she's driven solely by aggression.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Lost her edge," so "wants to pad her 
record" —"not even worth facing head-on."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf was someone she once 
respected above all others.

text_block_list.name: Young Sirius
text_block_list.text:
—...Haha! I can't get enough of those 
beastly eyes of yours after all! It makes 
me wanna bite right into you and make you 
flinch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had acknowledged me, and we were 
supposed to be pushing each other to 
greater heights, yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When you reunite after a long time, what 
if they've changed from the person you 
once looked up to—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be someone who can guide you— 
who can guide *all of you*."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, did they not wish for things to 
"return to the way they were"?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Sirius is an important Umamusume— One of 
the girls whose bright future I must wish 
for and guide.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she wanted things to go back to 
the way they were before—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I snap back to my senses.
choice_data_list: (No, Sirius denied it in the first place)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This is merely our own 
speculation—nothing more than a delusion. 
We must never let it run wild."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Besides, if this speculation turns out 
to be true, it's going to become a very 
delicate matter."
choice_data_list:
(For now, I'll just keep that in the back 
of my mind.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I resolved to keep a careful eye on the 
situation and act immediately if anything 
happened.
